description: This file defines the MetaInf class responsible for generating the META-INF/manifest.xml part of an OpenDocument spreadsheet file in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It creates XML output with manifest entries for various internal document files.

classes.name: MetaInf
classes.description: Represents the meta information manifest for ODS files, responsible for writing the manifest.xml structure.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Generates the XML content for the META-INF/manifest.xml file, including manifest entries for core ODS components.
